answer.rationale: Rollback is ruled out by compliance, so memory_b1 is not applicable. The degradation is confined to the primary region, which matches the March degradation pattern in memory_b2 where regional failover restored latency within minutes with clean traffic shift. Circuit breakers (b4) target partner/dependency outages, not internal primary-region write-path latency; read-replica routing (b5) relieves read load but this is the write path; adding capacity (b3) is a pre-provisioning play and too slow for an active 90-minute climb at settlement peak. Failover during heavy write traffic carries real risk of write disruption, so I verify memory_b2's source to confirm the prior failover preserved in-flight writes cleanly before committing.
